hypothesis: A bounded learned source-public successor change/novelty signal may provide earlier nonterminal policy-discriminating evidence where target-disappearance or terminal reward signals never changed any MG23 live decision. Audit sufficiency before changing native models or consuming new world seeds.

policy_proposal_protocol.causal_order: for each authentic recorded selected step, compute candidate proposal STRICTLY FROM PRECEDING selected source events of that same actor and original environment; then update ledger from original returned public source successor only
policy_proposal_protocol.score: for each context and previously selected action, public distinct successor count and nonterminal full public digest change count, penalize repeated same action; select highest positive observed change evidence, tie keep actual frozen parent proposal
policy_proposal_protocol.negative_control: same exact evidence ledger with change/novelty signal turned off returns frozen actual recorded action
policy_proposal_protocol.comparison: count strictly-evidence-backed offline action proposal divergences from actual frozen MG23 source policy; report evidence coverage, selected action success/failure and missing support
